0.title: Romans: The World's Most Influential Letter
0.truth: Romans explains timeless, essential truths for today and eternity.

1.title: Humanity's Need for the Gospel
1.truth: God reveals His saving power for all people through the gospel.

days.phrase: Lecture & Introduction notes
God called Paul to present the gospel to Roman believers.
Paul thanked God for the believers in Rome.
Paul longed to visit the believers in Rome.
Paul emphatically stated the gospel’s worth.
God reveals His saving power for all people through the gospel.

2.title: God's Wrath Against Sinful Humanity
2.truth: Nothing is more important than how we respond to God.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 1 notes
God reveals His wrath against sinful people.
Humanity exchanged worship of God for idolatry.
God gave humanity over to sexual sin.
God gave people over to sin’s depravity.
Nothing is more important than how we respond to God.

3.title: No Excuse for Anyone
3.truth: God alone perfectly judges every person.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 2 notes
Paul revealed shocking truth about God’s judgment.
God will bring judgment against all sinners.
Paul questioned the religious superiority of the Jews.
Paul defined true circumcision.
God alone perfectly judges every person.

4.title: No One Righteous
4.truth: All people are condemned for their sin and accountable to God.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 3 notes
Paul responded to objections about God’s faithfulness.
Paul responded to objections about God’s justice.
Paul described humanity’s sinful condition using Old Testament passages.
Paul concluded his thoughts on human unrighteousness.
All people are condemned for their sin and accountable to God.

5.title: How God Saves Sinners
5.truth: God has made the way to be declared right with Him.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 4 notes
Righteousness from God has been made known.
All people need the salvation God offers by grace through faith.
Jesus’s blood atones for humanity’s sin.
God’s justice has been satisfied.
God has made the way to be declared right with Him.

6.title: Justification by Faith, Part 1
6.truth: God justifies people through faith in Christ alone.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 5 notes
Paul revealed faith’s impact on pride.
Paul declared faith’s role in salvation.
Paul affirmed there is one God and one path to justification.
Paul asserted that justification by faith upholds God’s law.
God justifies people through faith in Christ alone.

7.title: Justification by Faith, Part 2
7.truth: God gives Christ’s righteousness to those who believe in Him.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 6 notes
Abraham’s example demonstrates that God justifies the ungodly.
David’s example demonstrates that God forgives and covers sin.
Righteousness comes by faith.
God made Abraham the father of all who believe.
God gives Christ’s righteousness to those who believe in Him.

8.title: Peace with God
8.truth: Believers have peace with God and hope in all circumstances.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 7 notes
Justification brings believers peace with God.
Suffering produces fruit in the lives of believers.
God demonstrates His love for sinners through Christ’s death.
Christ’s life and death offer salvation to sinners.
Believers have peace with God and hope in all circumstances.

9.title: God's Gift of Righteousness
9.truth: Christ’s gift of righteousness triumphs over Adam’s sin.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 8 notes
Sin and death entered the world through one man.
Paul contrasted God’s gift and Adam’s trespass.
Paul explained the consequences of the gift and the trespass.
Adam brought sin, but by grace Jesus brought life.
Christ’s gift of righteousness triumphs over Adam’s sin.

10.title: Death to Sin
10.truth: A believer’s new identity in Christ frees them from sin’s power.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 9 notes
Paul taught that believers no longer live in sin.
Paul used baptism to illustrate a believer’s death to sin.
Believers are eternally united with Christ.
Believers should view themselves through their union with Christ.
A believer’s new identity in Christ frees them from sin’s power.

11.title: Alive to God
11.truth: God’s grace makes believers eternally right with Him and frees them to live holy lives.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 10 notes
Paul gave four commands and a promise.
Paul explained why believers under grace should not sin.
Paul thanked God for setting believers free from sin.
Paul contrasted the results of serving sin with seeking God’s righteousness.
God’s grace makes believers eternally right with Him and frees them to live holy lives.

12.title: The Law and the Believer
12.truth: Believers belong to Jesus even as they struggle against sin.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 11 notes
Paul explained a believer’s freedom from the law.
Paul described how sin and the law work in the lives of people.
Paul explained his own internal battle with sin.
Paul cried out for complete deliverance from his sinful nature.
Believers belong to Jesus even as they struggle against sin.

13.title: Life Through the Spirit
13.truth: The Holy Spirit empowers God’s children to live holy lives.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 12 notes
Paul proclaimed that believers are free from sin’s condemnation.
Paul described two different mindsets.
Paul exhorted believers regarding a new obligation.
Paul explained believers’ new status with God.
The Holy Spirit empowers God’s children to live holy lives.

14.title: Suffering and Glory
14.truth: Believers eagerly await God’s promised eternal glory.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 13 notes
Paul compared suffering with glory.
Creation groans in frustration and bondage.
God’s people groan.
The Holy Spirit groans.
Believers eagerly await God’s promised eternal glory.

15.title: Secure in God's Love
15.truth: God’s people rest securely in His good purposes, salvation, and love.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 14 notes
Paul revealed a great promise.
Paul offered understanding regarding God’s sovereign purpose for His people.
Paul offered questions and answers regarding the spiritual benefits God’s people experience through faith.
Paul proclaimed nothing could separate God’s people from His love.
God’s people rest securely in His good purposes, salvation, and love.

16.title: God's Sovereignty in Salvation
16.truth: God is sovereign over His creation and faithfully keeps His promises.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 15 notes
Paul grieved for unbelieving Israelites.
Paul affirmed that God’s word to Israel had not failed.
Paul addressed questions about God’s sovereign election.
Paul offered examples to illustrate God’s sovereign purposes.
God is sovereign over His creation and faithfully keeps His promises.

17.title: Our Responsibility in Salvation
17.truth: Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 16 notes
Paul highlighted the differences between how Jews and Gentiles pursued righteousness.
Paul fervently prayed for the zealous Israelites who lacked knowledge.
Paul quoted Moses to contrast righteousness by the law with righteousness by faith.
Paul affirmed that there is only one way to saving righteousness.
Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

18.title: Our Privilege in Salvation
18.truth: God faithfully sends His messengers to proclaim Christ to the world.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 17 notes
Paul unfolded faith’s progression from belief to calling on Jesus.
Paul highlighted the privilege of sharing the truth about Christ.
Paul recognized that not everyone would respond to the gospel.
Through Old Testament quotes, Paul proved that Israel had heard and understood the message about Jesus.
God faithfully sends His messengers to proclaim Christ to the world.

19.title: Salvation for the Gentiles and for Israel
19.truth: God always works to accomplish His perfect plan for all people.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 18 notes
Paul reasoned that God has not rejected the Jewish people.
Israel experienced hardened hearts in their disobedience.
Paul expressed hope for Gentiles and Israel alike.
Paul discussed Israel’s promised restoration.
God always works to accomplish His perfect plan for all people.

20.title: All Glory to God Forever
20.truth: God’s absolute superiority calls for unending praise.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 19 notes
Paul broke forth into a doxology of praise to God.
Paul asked two questions regarding God.
Paul asked a third question about God.
Paul praised God for who He is.
God’s absolute superiority calls for unending praise.

21.title: Christian Worship and Service
21.truth: God transforms and equips surrendered believers for the good of Christ’s body.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 20 notes
Paul urged believers to offer God their bodies as living sacrifices.
Paul called believers to be transformed by renewing their minds.
Paul described the unity and diversity of Christ’s body, the Church.
Paul exhorted believers to serve God and others with their unique gifts.
God transforms and equips surrendered believers for the good of Christ’s body.

22.title: Christian Love
22.truth: God calls His people to love like He does.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 21 notes
Paul called believers to love sincerely and hate evil.
Paul called believers to selfless, persevering, generous love.
Paul taught God’s loving strategies for healthy relationships.
Paul explained Christians’ responsibility to all people, including their enemies.
God calls His people to love like He does.

23.title: Christian Submission to Authority
23.truth: God sovereignly places people in positions of authority.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 22 notes
Paul issued a demand regarding governing authorities.
Paul explained the consequence of refusal to submit to authority.
Paul gave reasons for the Roman believers to submit to authority.
Paul exhorted believers to live rightly before God and others.
God sovereignly places people in positions of authority.

24.title: Christian Living
24.truth: Jesus’s promised return calls believers to live holy lives of love.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 23 notes
Paul explained the believer’s debt of love.
Paul called believers to wake up from slumber.
Paul urged believers to step out of the darkness.
Paul told believers to clothe themselves in Christ.
Jesus’s promised return calls believers to live holy lives of love.

25.title: Christian Liberty
25.truth: God calls believers to love one another even when they disagree on disputable matters.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 24 notes
Paul taught believers how to treat others when they hold different views about disputable issues.
Paul reminded believers that Jesus is the risen Lord and judge of all.
Paul encouraged believers not to create obstacles for others with their lifestyle practices.
Paul pointed believers toward lives that promote peace and mutual edification.
God calls believers to love one another even when they disagree on disputable matters.

26.title: Christian Unity
26.truth: God empowers believers to live in unity and hope as they follow Christ.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 25 notes
Paul assigned responsibilities to strong believers.
Paul spoke to Scripture’s important role in Christian unity.
Paul spoke about acceptance of other believers.
Paul spoke words of hope to His readers.
God empowers believers to live in unity and hope as they follow Christ.

27.title: Paul's Ministry and Plans
27.truth: God invites His people to join in His gospel work.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 26 notes
Paul commended the Roman believers.
Paul explained his God-given ministry.
Paul desired to visit Rome.
Paul urged the Roman believers to pray for his ministry.
God invites His people to join in His gospel work.

28.title: The Gospel's Impact in Rome and Corinth
28.truth: Godly relationships reflect the transformative power of the gospel.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 27 notes
Paul greeted beloved believers in Rome.
Paul offered a warning to the believers in Rome.
Believers in Corinth greeted the believers in Rome.
Paul gave glory to God forever through Jesus Christ.
Godly relationships reflect the transformative power of the gospel.

29.title: Responding to the World's Most Influential Letter
29.truth: The Holy Spirit grows believers in holiness as they reflect on and rightly respond to the gospel.

days.phrase: Lecture & Lesson 28 notes
Paul greeted believers in Rome and reminded them of humanity’s need for God’s righteousness.
Paul explained how God accomplished salvation by grace through faith in Jesus Christ.
Paul worshipped God after explaining His sovereign plan to save both Jews and Gentiles.
Paul concluded his letter by calling believers to love and live holy lives.
The Holy Spirit grows believers in holiness as they reflect on and rightly respond to the gospel.

30.title: Reflections on This Year's Study
30.truth: Sharing Day! One of the best nights of our year together.

Magnifying God
